biotools.summary: Checks whether a cancer cell line's genotype labels hold. For each line and gene it reads every DepMap sequencing entry of the model, relative copy number, RNA expression, CRISPR gene-effect readouts and Cellosaurus curated records, and says whether a wild-type label is supported, questioned or contradicted, with identity warnings for misidentified, contaminated and same-patient lines. Free for 5 lines and 10 genes per check (verdicts); paid plans add the evidence behind each verdict, whole panels, CSV, a methods paragraph and an API. Built on DepMap Public 24Q4 and Cellosaurus (both CC BY 4.0).
